sites.name: Pack & Trek
sites.bookText:
Pack & Trek (Shop #23)
“The air inside this luggage store is thick with the 
scent of dust and aged leather. Rows of overturned 
suitcases and duffel bags clutter the floor, some burst 
open  with  their  forgotten  contents  scattered—old 
travel brochures, broken zippers, and the occasional 
half-packed  wardrobe  left  in  eternal  departure.  A 
promotional poster of a smiling family at an airport still 
hangs  on  the  back  wall,  now  slashed  down  the 
middle, their faces warped by grime and time. The 
silence is deceptive—something shifts in the shadows 
between  the  shelves,  and  the  faint  rustling  of  a 
partially unzipped bag suggests you’re not alone…”
General Description
Pack & Trek was once a mid-tier travel store, selling 
everything from sturdy backpacks to luxury rolling 
suitcases. Now, its interior is a chaotic mess of half-
looted luggage, security tags still dangling from zippers, 
and travel accessories abandoned mid-purchase. The 
store is well-stocked with containers, bags, and 
practical survival tools—but also carries an unsettling 
sense of foreboding. Some of these bags were packed 
in a hurry, their owners never returning to claim them.

Layout: Long aisles of suitcases and 
backpacks, a backroom storage area behind a 
metal security door (slightly ajar), and a 
checkout counter with a register still locked.

Threats: Something has nested in the 
backroom. The occasional sound of shifting 
fabric suggests something inside the larger 
suitcases isn’t quite… dead.

Hazards: The floor is littered with rolling 
suitcases, making it a challenge to move 
quickly without tripping (Dex DC 12 to avoid 
falling prone if running).
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (1d4 on Entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
 251 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
1
Falling Luggage Tower – A 
precarious stack of suitcases 
topples over, creating a loud crash. 
(+1d4 Tension, 25% chance to 
wake sleeping zombies in the 
store)
2
Sticky Floor Section – A spilled 
bottle of travel shampoo makes an 
area slippery. (Dexterity DC 14 or 
fall prone for 1 round.)
3
Locked Security Gate – The 
backroom is partially blocked by a 
metal security shutter, requiring 
Strength DC 15 to lift or Dexterity 
DC 14 to squeeze under without 
noise.
4
Rummaging Hands – A suitcase 
jerks open on its own. 
Something is inside. (Triggers 
enemy roll immediately.)
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Tactical Backpack (35 SV) – 
Increases carrying capacity. A note 
inside reads: “Going to the airport
—should be safe there…”
2
Hidden Cash Stash (50 SV as 
trade currency) – Found in a 
secret zipper compartment of a 
high-end rolling suitcase.
3
Survival Kit (25 SV) – Mini first aid, 
compact flashlight, and travel-sized 
water purifier.
4
Luxury Carry-On Suitcase (20 
SV) – Useless in combat but 
valuable for bartering. The initials 
“J.M.” are embroidered on the 
leather.
5
Foldable Camping Stove (40 SV) 
– Can be used to cook food without 
drawing attention with fire.
6
Mysterious Locked Briefcase 
(???) – No key. Contents 
unknown. Could be junk, a 
valuable document, or 
something… else.
Ambiguous Lore
d4 Roll Clue Found Inside a Suitcase
1
Airline Boarding Pass – One-way 
ticket to an unnamed island. Date: 
The day before the outbreak.
2
Military Passport Holder – 
Contains BioDyne clearance 
documents, listing “Project 
Prometheus - Phase 2.”
3
Religious Pamphlet – Title: “The 
Sixth Seal is Broken! Seek the 
Island of the Pure!” Stamped with a 
bloodied handprint.
4
Audio Recorder (Nonfunctional) – 
Label reads: “Survivors found at 
Gate 7. No infections. Holding 
pattern until evac. Do NOT open 
bags.”
XP & Survival Value (SV)

Securing the store (clearing all threats): 200 
SV

Fully looting the store: Up to 250 SV based 
on stored supplies

Unlocking the mysterious briefcase (if 
valuable): Additional 75 SV

Finding and deciphering lore clues: 50 SV 
each
Tension Impact
Action
Effect on Tension
Making loud noise 
+1d4 Tension
 252 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
Action
Effect on Tension
(falling luggage, 
sprinting)
Opening the security 
shutter
+1d6 Tension
Triggering an enemy 
encounter
+2d6 Tension
Using a firearm inside 
the store
+3d6 Tension
Potential Enemies
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Suitcase Stalkers (1d3) – 
Luggage-bound zombies that burst 
out when disturbed. They move 
slowly but grapple prey (Strength 
DC 13 to escape).
3
Hoarder’s Corpse – A dead body 
clutching a suitcase full of supplies. 
It doesn’t move… until you try to 
take it (Fast zombie, high Dex).
4
The Traveler – A strange zombie 
in a flight attendant uniform, 
whispering something in another 
language. Its bite has a 
hallucinogenic effect (Wisdom 
Save DC 14 or suffer a vision of 
“The Island”).
5
Mimic Suitcase – A grotesquely 
mutated zombie has grown inside 
a rolling suitcase. When a survivor 
gets too close, it snaps open, 
biting (1d10 damage, 25% 
chance of infection).
6
The Smuggler’s Remains – An 
unusually fresh corpse, 
uninfected but filled with 
something… unnatural. (May be 
tied to a future plotline.)
Monster Stats
Suitcase Stalkers (1d3)

HP: 10 each

Attack: Bite (1d6)

Special: When killed, releases rotting 
luggage contents (25% chance of useful loot).
The Traveler (Special)

HP: 20

Attack: Slashing nails (1d6)

Special: Whispers of the Island – Anyone hit 
by its attack must roll Wisdom Save DC 14 or 
hallucinate for 1 round.
Mimic Suitcase

HP: 15

Attack: Bite Ambush (1d10, Dex DC 13 to 
avoid first attack)

Special: Resistant to bludgeoning damage 
but weak to fire.
Survival XP & Strategic 
Options

If the survivors clear the store quietly, they 
gain bonus XP (+50 SV).

If they trigger the nest, they must deal with 
extra enemies but may find higher-value loot.

If they stealthily loot without waking the 
zombies, they avoid tension gain entirely but 
only collect half the potential SV.
Pack & Trek - Summary

Valuable for backpacks, travel gear, and 
supply containers.

Stealth-focused room—too much noise could 
attract outside threats.
 253 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall

Hidden lore hooks suggest connections to 
the larger mystery (The Island, BioDyne, 
cultists).

Multiple playstyles—sneak past the dangers, 
fight them head-on, or loot selectively to 
minimize risk.

sites.name: Gadget Galaxy
sites.bookText:
Gadget Galaxy (Shop #24)
“Rows of empty shelves stand like tombstones in the 
ruins of Gadget Galaxy, once a haven for the tech-
obsessed. The shattered glass display cases reflect 
flickering emergency exit signs, their dying red glow 
casting  jagged  shadows.  The  massive  75-inch 
televisions hang from the wall, cracked and silent, 
their last images frozen in time. A faint burnt-plastic 
smell lingers in the air, mixing with the metallic tang of 
dried blood. The store’s security cameras droop from 
the ceiling like dead eyes, their shattered lenses a 
grim reminder that no one is watching anymore. In 
the corner, a motion-sensitive toy suddenly chirps to 
life, repeating a distorted, static-laced greeting. ‘H-h-
hi there! P-p-play with me!’ Then silence.”
General Description

Layout: Gadget Galaxy is a mid-sized 
electronics store specializing in consumer 
gadgets, TVs, laptops, phones, and home 
security tech. It has a front sales floor, a 
demo section, a customer service counter, 
and a staff-only repair room in the back. A 
half-shuttered security gate partially blocks 
the entrance.

Threats:
o
1d4 Shamblers idly bump into 
shelves, tangled in cords.
o
1 “Short-Circuited” Cyber-Zombie 
fused with malfunctioning electronics. 
Sparks occasionally flicker from its 
exposed wiring.

Hazards:
o
Live Wires: Exposed electrical wiring 
near the checkout area (Dex Save DC 
14 or take 2d6 shock damage).
o
Unstable Shelves: The earthquake-
like tremors of earlier panic looting 
have left shelves teetering 
dangerously. A sudden disturbance 
(Loud Noise or Combat) may trigger a 
shelf collapse (Dex Save DC 12 or 
take 1d6 bludgeoning).
o
Motion-Sensor Toys: Stepping too 
close to the demo aisle may activate a 
random electronic toy, producing 
sudden noise (+1d4 Tension).
Encounter Elements
Random Store Events (1d6 on Entry or after 10 
Minutes)
d6 Roll
Event
1
TV Jumpscare: One of the 
cracked TVs suddenly flickers to 
life, showing distorted static. A 
voice whispers, “They see you.” 
(No real effect, but unnerving).
2
Power Surge: A nearby device 
short-circuits, releasing a burst 
of sparks (1d6 Fire Damage if 
touching metal).
3
Hacked Alarm System: A nearby 
laptop screen suddenly displays a 
looping message: “HELP ME. 
TRAPPED. SERVICE ROOM.”
4
Creepy Phone Call: A still-
powered phone rings 
unexpectedly. If answered, only 
garbled breathing and a faint 
metallic clicking can be heard.
5
Doomed Survivor’s Last Words: 
A laptop with a recorded video 
message shows a frantic survivor 
speaking: “They adapt. They 
listen. The Mall isn’t safe. The 
servers… the servers know.” 
(Raises Tension +1d6)
6
Silent Stalker: A nearby 
mannequin dressed as a store 
 254 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
mascot has mysteriously 
moved since last seen. (It does 
not attack… yet.)
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Handheld Radio Scanner – Picks 
up survivor broadcasts & encrypted 
military signals (50 SV).
2
Laptop with Encrypted Data – 
Requires Intelligence Check (DC 
16) to decrypt (reveals Lore, 
possibly BioDyne files).
3
Drone (Broken) – Can be repaired 
(Int DC 14) for aerial recon. 
Otherwise, salvageable parts (30 
SV).
4
Battery Pack – Rechargeable 
power source (30 SV, useful for 
security systems or emergency 
power).
5
Taser Baton – 1d8 Shock 
Damage, short-range melee 
weapon, 3 charges before requiring 
recharge.
6
Smart Glasses (Cracked, Still 
Functional) – Auto-identifies 
weak points in enemies (grants 
+1 to attack rolls when scanning 
zombies for a round).
Ambiguous Lore
Among the wreckage, players might find eerie hints 
about the apocalypse’s origins:
d4 Roll Lore Clue
1
Printout from BioDyne Corp: 
“Project Echo-9: Neural 
Cybernetics Testing—DO NOT 
CONNECT TO MAINFRAME.”
2
Partially Redacted Email: 
“Security Override Code 331-
ZULU. If systems go haywire, shut 
down all connections before—” 
(Message ends abruptly).
3
Abandoned Tech Manual: “AI-
assisted surveillance. Phase 3: 
Active Threat Containment?” 
Scribbled notes add, “Does it 
understand us?”
4
Encrypted Hard Drive (Locked, 
Needs Repair) – Marked 
“CONFIDENTIAL - Mall AI Control 
Logs.” (Decryption DC 18).

Tension Impact

Any loud noise (breaking TVs, collapsing 
shelves, triggered toys) increases Tension 
by 1d4.

Activating store power (if repaired) raises 
Tension by +2d6, as outside zombies may 
notice lights/sounds.
Enemies in the Store
Cyber-Zombie (Short-Circuited Tech-Hybrid)

HP: 22
 255 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall

AC: 13 (Metallic Skin)

Speed: 20 ft

Attacks:
o
Electro-Grasp: +4 to hit, 1d6 shock 
damage + Grapple (DC 14 STR to 
break).
o
EMP Discharge (Recharge 4-6): 
Disrupts electronics within 20 ft, 
disabling powered devices for 1 
minute.

Special: Weak to blunt force damage (Hitting 
with a heavy object disrupts its circuits, making 
it lose a turn).
Shamblers (1d4)

HP: 12

AC: 10

Speed: Slow (15 ft)

Attacks: Bite (1d6 damage, possible infection)
Survivor Strategies & Story 
Hooks
Ways Players Can Use This Store:
- Set Up a Safe Zone: With enough effort, this location 
could serve as a communications hub, relaying 
messages to other survivors.
- Investigate the Lore: Hacking into the store’s back-
end might unlock secrets about the Mall’s fate.
- Lure Zombies Into a Trap: The TVs and sound 
systems can be rigged to create distractions or 
ambush points.
Potential NPC Connection:
- A Hidden Survivor (or Rogue AI?) might be using 
the remaining power grid to communicate.
- If they decrypt the Encrypted Laptop, they may 
receive a broadcast leading them to a secret 
underground research area…

sites.name: Deli Delights
sites.bookText:
Deli Delights (Shop #25)
“The scent of old spices and decayed meat lingers in 
the air of this upscale delicatessen, blending with a 
faint, acrid tang of dried blood. A long glass display 
case stretches across the front, its surface smeared 
with  handprints—some  human,  some…  less  so. 
Behind the counter, a still-functioning industrial meat 
slicer hums softly, its blade clean despite the carnage 
elsewhere. Hooks dangle from the ceiling, swaying 
slightly,  some  still  clutching  unrecognizable, 
desiccated remains. The walls are lined with half-
looted  shelves  of  imported  goods,  their  packaging 
faded but intact. Something in here drips.”
General Description
Deli Delights was once a high-end delicatessen 
specializing in gourmet meats, fine cheeses, and 
imported preserves. The store is in surprisingly good 
condition, but signs of struggle are everywhere—
shattered glass, overturned shelves, and a deep 
crimson smear leading to the walk-in freezer.

Layout: The front counter holds a working 
industrial meat slicer and a register covered in 
dried blood. A set of metal shelves against the 
back wall contains imported canned meats, 
vacuum-sealed sausages, and jars of olives 
and pickles. A door behind the counter leads 
into a walk-in freezer, its heavy metal door 
slightly ajar. A side storage room remains 
locked.

Threats: Something inside the freezer is 
moving, slow and deliberate.

Hazards: The slicer is still active and 
dangerously sharp. The hanging meat hooks 
pose a risk if bumped into.
Hazards & Environmental 
Traps (Roll 1d4 on Entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
The Meat Slicer Incident: An old 
corpse slumps against the counter
—if disturbed, it falls, knocking the 
slicer on full power. Anyone 
nearby must make a DEX Save 
(DC 14) or take 2d8 slashing 
damage. Loud noise adds +1d6 
Tension.
 256 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
2
Grease Slick: A pool of rancid 
meat grease coats part of the floor. 
Moving too fast here requires a 
DEX Save (DC 12) or risk slipping, 
becoming prone and vulnerable 
for 1 round.
3
Rotten Meat Hook: A severed 
arm dangles from a hook, 
twitched by unseen movement. 
If approached without caution, it 
drops suddenly, causing a fright 
check (WIS Save DC 12) and 
potentially attracting zombies.
4
Sudden Freezer Malfunction: 
The freezer’s motor kicks back 
to life unexpectedly. Loud 
mechanical groans fill the air. 
+2d6 Tension immediately. If 
players investigate, they may 
find something inside… alive.
Interactables & Loot
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Imported Canned Meats (5 SV 
each, 10 total) – Still edible. Adds to 
food supply.
2
Jar of Ghost Peppers – Can be 
used as a makeshift weapon (1d6 
fire damage) or food.
3
Aged Cheese Wheels (4 SV each, 
3 total) – Long-lasting, valuable for 
barter.
4
Butcher’s Cleaver (Melee, 1d8 
slashing) – Heavy, good for close 
combat.
5
Meat Hook (Melee, 1d6 piercing, 
grapples on hit) – Can be used as 
a weapon.
6
Mysterious Sealed Box (locked, 
STR DC 14 to open) – Contains 
$500 cash (worthless), a note in 
blood (“THEY’RE IN THE 
FREEZER”), and an ID badge for 
BioDyne Corporation. 
(Ambiguous Lore)
The Freezer Encounter
Inside the Freezer:
The freezer’s interior is coated in a thin layer of frost, 
streaked with old blood. Hanging carcasses—some 
animal, some not—sway slightly from rusted hooks. In 
the back, a survivor corpse sits against the wall, its 
torso flayed open. In its lap is a journal, written in 
shaking hands. The last entry reads:
“It wasn’t hunger. It wasn’t infection. Something in the 
meat. In the meat. IN THE MEAT—”
Beneath the body, the frost is melting.
Enemy Encounter (Roll 1d6 on Opening Freezer)
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Meat Locker Shamblers (2-3 
zombies) – Frozen, slow-moving 
but harder to kill (resist slashing 
damage).
3
Gourmand Horror – A bloated, 
skinless humanoid fused with 
butchered meat. It throws chunks 
of rotting flesh (1d6 damage, 
poison effect).
4
Survivor-Turned-Wendigo – A 
former human who lasted too long 
in the freezer, now feral and fast 
(AC 14, bite 2d6, disease risk).
5
Something in the Meat (Mimic 
Horror) – A skinned, moving 
carcass lunges from a hanging 
hook, attempting to wrap around 
and suffocate prey.
6
Frozen BioDyne Experiment – A 
corpse reanimates mid-
investigation, possessing 
enhanced strength and 
endurance. (AC 15, double HP, 
 257

attacks cause frostbite).
Ambiguous Lore
d4 Roll Hidden Clue
1
Receipts in the Register – Lists 
“special deliveries” from an 
unknown BioDyne supplier, dated 
after the apocalypse began.
2
Bloodstained Note Under 
Counter – “Don’t eat it. Don’t eat it. 
IT’S NOT MEAT.”
3
Survivor’s Journal (found in 
freezer) – Mentions “meat that 
twitched on its own” before the 
outbreak.
4
Old Security Camera (working) – 
Can be rewound to show a man 
devouring raw meat… then 
suddenly collapsing, twitching 
violently.



(instant zombie attraction).


awareness by +3d6 Tension.

Leaving the freezer door open guarantees



sites.name: Look & See
sites.bookText:
Look & See (Shop #26)
“A shattered front window yawns open like a broken 
tooth, glass crunching underfoot as you step inside 
the dimly lit optometry shop. Rows of stylish eyeglass 
frames  still  rest  on  wall-mounted  displays,  their 
lenses reflecting flickering emergency lights from the 
ceiling. A knocked-over chair and a half-spilled bottle 
of cleaning solution sit near the front desk, as if the 
last customer left in a hurry. In the back, a heavy eye 
examination machine looms like some forgotten relic, 
its adjustable metal arms stretching out like skeletal 
fingers. A faint rustling sound echoes from deeper 
within the store—something is moving.”
General Description
Once a sleek and modern vision care boutique, Look & 
See has now become a ruined, dust-choked relic of the 
past. The store features:

A Front Display Area – Racks of eyeglasses, 
overturned promotional stands, and a 
receptionist’s desk.

The Examination Room – A back room 
featuring old optometry equipment, a medical 
cabinet, and a few chairs.

A Storage Closet – An employee-only area 
filled with extra frames, lens cleaner, and 
scattered medical files.

A Back Door – A locked maintenance exit 
leading into the mall’s service corridors.
The store’s motion sensors still flicker to life 
occasionally, causing security alarms to beep faintly 
before dying again. The air is thick with dust and the 
sharp tang of alcohol-based lens cleaner.
Threats & Hazards
Enemy Encounters (Roll 1d6 when searching the 
store)
d6 Roll Encounter
1-2
Shamblers (1d4) – Four eyeglass-
wearing zombies lurk in the back, 
their cracked lenses barely hiding 
their clouded eyes.
3
Crawler Zombie (1) – A former 
employee now fused to the floor 
behind the counter, its torso 
dragging forward as it tries to bite 
ankles.
4
Surprise Attack – Glass Shard 
Swarm – A small pile of shattered 
lenses suddenly shifts as a hand 
bursts through—an undead patient 
has been buried under debris.
5
Hollow-Eyed Stalker – A thin, 
unnaturally quiet zombie stands in 
front of an optometry mirror, 
perfectly still, as if waiting to attack.
6
Strange Reflection (No immediate 
threat) – A character checking a 
mirror sees themselves blink at 
the wrong time. No zombies 
appear, but paranoia lingers.
Environmental Hazards
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Shattered Glass Hazard – Walking 
carelessly in the store requires a 
Dexterity save (DC 12) or suffer 1d4 
damage from glass cuts.
2
Auto-Closing Door – The back 
door’s power mechanism is 
damaged. Anyone who enters the 
back room must make a Strength 
check (DC 13) to keep it from 
slamming shut loudly (+1d6 
Tension).
3
Faulty Motion Sensor Alarm – 
Flickers unpredictably, causing a 
sharp beep-beep-beep before 
dying. Roll 1d6: on a 6, a distant 
zombie horde is drawn closer.
4
Eyeglass Display Collapse – 
Bumping into a shaky metal shelf 
triggers a loud crash, increasing 
Tension by +1d4 and alerting

d6 Roll Notable Items
1

SV each) – Can improve vision for 
specific characters or be traded for 
supplies.
2

Prevents eye infections, restores 
temporary vision loss from dust or 
debris.
3
Optometry Tools (25 SV) – Useful 
for crafting small mechanical repairs 
or bartering with survivors.
4
Strong Magnifying Lens (10 SV) – 
Can aid in small crafting work, 
reading fine print, or starting fires in 
sunlight.
5
Old CCTV Monitor – Still hooked 
up, cycles through distorted mall 
security footage (Lore Clue).
6
Locked Storage Cabinet – 
Requires a Dexterity check (DC 
14) to open. Contains a single 
emergency flashlight and a 
loaded .22 pistol (15 SV).
Ambiguous Lore Clues (Roll 
1d4 when searching the store)
d4 Roll Mystery Clue
1
“Biodyne Research Corp – 
Employee Vision Test Results” – 
A medical chart lists unusual pupil 
dilation readings for multiple mall 
employees. Some notes mention 
“altered neural response.”
2
Bloodied Patient Card – A half-
crushed ID badge lists a “Dr. Phillip 
Graves” with a note: “Do NOT let 
him leave before treatment.”
3
Strange Surveillance Footage – 
The flickering CCTV monitor shows 
a recording from two days before 
the outbreak. A woman in a white 
lab coat examines a patient, but 
suddenly gasps, stares directly at 
the camera, and the footage cuts 
off.
4
Hanging Eye Chart – Someone 
has scrawled in blood over the 
letters, forming a warning 
message that only makes sense 
when read from a distance. 
(“DON’T SEE IT”).

sites.name: Perk Down! Café
sites.bookText:
Perk Down! Café (Shop 
#27)
“The  scent  of  stale  espresso  lingers  in  the  air, 
mingling with the acrid bite of spilled milk long since 
curdled. Dim neon signage flickers above the barista 
counter,  casting  erratic  shadows  across  upturned 
tables and shattered ceramic cups. A thick layer of 
dust coats the coffee grinders and syrup dispensers, 
as if time stopped mid-shift. Behind the counter, an 
old radio hums softly, its static occasionally giving 
way  to  eerie  snippets  of  speech—muffled  voices, 
distant screams, or distorted jazz from nowhere. A 
half-drunk  cappuccino  still  sits  on  the  register,  its 
foam hardened into a grotesque crust. You are not 
alone here.”
Description

Layout: Perk Down! is the forgotten lower 
branch of Perk Up!, once a hipster favorite 
before the apocalypse. The café is compact, 
with an ordering counter up front, a seating 
area with mismatched chairs and tables, and a 
storage room in the back. A half-broken 
espresso machine dominates the counter, next 
to a cash register with its drawer pried open. 
Behind the counter is an old radio, still 
mysteriously active.

Threats: 1d4 Shamblers slouched in café 
booths, heads down like sleeping patrons. If 
disturbed, they lurch up suddenly, still clutching 
half-eaten pastries. One corpse behind the 
counter is fresher, twitching unnaturally (1 
Crawler Zombie hidden).

Hazards: The café is cluttered with spilled 
sugar packets and glass shards. The flickering 
sign may draw attention if tampered with. The 
back storage room door is wedged shut (STR 
DC 15 to force open), but something inside is 
scratching at the wood.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Espresso Stimulants – A bag of 
unspoiled high-caffeine espresso 
beans (usable as a mild stimulant: 
Advantage on CON saves 
vs. exhaustion for 8 hours). Worth 
10 SV.
2
Cracked Radio – Still operational, 
but unstable. Every hour, it picks up 
strange transmissions (see 
 261 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
Ambiguous Lore). Can be salvaged 
(50 SV) or repaired (INT DC 16) for 
clearer signals.
3
Barista’s Toolbox – A hidden 
compartment under the counter 
contains a wrench, screwdriver, and 
a box cutter (counts as Improvised 
Dagger, 1d4 damage). Worth 15 
SV.
4
Hidden Cash Stash – Someone 
left a wad of bills taped under the 
register. Useless as currency, but 
the rubber bands and 
paperweight inside are valuable for 
crafting (5 SV).
5
Sugary Fuel – A stash of energy 
bars and bottled cold brews in the 
mini fridge, still good! Worth 15 
SV, or can be used to restore 1d6 
HP if consumed.
6
The Black Cup – A strange, 
perfectly black coffee cup behind 
the register. When held, it feels 
heavier than it should. (See 
Ambiguous Lore).
Ambiguous Lore: What 
Happened Here?
d4 Roll Clue Found
1
“The Signal Knows.” A note is 
scrawled on a discarded receipt: 
“Turn the dial to 101.3 at midnight. 
They know I’m here. The signal 
sees. Help me.”
2
The Broadcast Glitch. The radio 
occasionally plays an emergency 
broadcast in reverse, mentioning 
“containment failure,” “Unit Zulu”, 
and “sleeper activation codes.”
3
The Door Warning. Scratched into 
the storage room door: “DO NOT 
OPEN. STILL MOVING.” The wood 
is deeply gouged. Bloodstains 
suggest someone tried to escape… 
or keep something inside.
4
A Perfect Cup. The Black Cup 
has no manufacturer marks. 
Anyone drinking from it must roll 
WIS Save (DC 15) or experience a 
flash of another life—memories 
of a barista, an old man in a 
bunker, or something alien 
staring back through static.
Tension Impact
Action
Tension Increase
Playing the 
radio at full 
volume
+2d6 Tension (Broadcast 
heard by nearby zombies)
Breaking 
glass or 
tipping over 
furniture
+1d4 Tension
Forcing open 
the storage 
room
Instantly triggers 1d6 zombie 
spawn + +1d6 Tension
Drinking 
from The 
Black Cup
No Tension increase, but the 
player now hears the 
radio… even when it’s off.

SV Earned

of threats
150 SV

Espresso Stimulants
10 SV

50 SV

you leave with it…)
Enemies (Random Encounter 
Table)
d6 Roll
Enemy Encountered
1-2
Shambler Café-Goers (1d4) – 
Sitting corpses suddenly awaken 
when approached.
3
Crawler Barista – The dead 
cashier behind the counter pulls 
itself up at first noise (AC 12, 8 
HP, Bite 1d6).
4
Horde in the Storage Room 
(1d6) – If forced open, a mass of 
bodies collapses out, all still 
moving.
5
Radio Phantom – If the radio is 
left on too long, a shadowy 
figure is glimpsed in the reflection 
of the coffee machines. (No 
immediate attack… but is it 
watching?)
6
The Sleeper – A seemingly 
dead man slumped in a booth. 
If touched, he whispers in a 
strange language… and then 
charges with unnatural speed 
(AC 14, HP 20, attacks twice per 
round).
Optional Special Encounter: 
The Last Order
If players sit at a booth for at least one minute, the 
café’s espresso machine turns on by itself. A hot 
cup of coffee appears on the counter. No one poured 
it. The radio crackles.
If a player drinks it:
- They heal 1d10 HP.
- They gain Advantage on Perception checks for 1 
hour.
- The next time they sleep, they will dream of a 
place they’ve never been… but somehow recognize.
If they ignore it, the cup slowly empties on its own 
over time.
Final Thoughts

Perk Down! is a low-threat, high-weirdness 
encounter, great for setting the mood of “the 
mall is watching” while offering minor loot.

The radio can serve as a plot hook, leading 
players to other clues about the true cause of 
the outbreak.

Players may return here later to check new 
radio transmissions—or to realize the Black 
Cup has moved… closer.
GM Notes:

The Tension System ensures that every 
noise, every action adds risk—especially if 
players linger too long.

The radio can be used for hidden 
transmissions, plot advancement, or 
creeping dread.

Drinking the mysterious coffee is an easy 
way to plant long-term paranoia in players.

sites.name: Evergreen Home & Garden
sites.bookText:
Evergreen Home & Garden 
(Shop #28)
“The scent of damp earth lingers in the air as you 
step into Evergreen Home & Garden. Rows of dead 
or overgrown plants sit in cracked ceramic pots, vines 
creeping along the walls as if reclaiming the store for  
nature. A large  indoor greenhouse dominates the 
back  half  of  the  store,  its  glass  walls  covered  in 
condensation and moss. Dim light filters through a 
skylight  above,  casting  eerie  shifting  shadows 
through the overgrowth. The hum of an old ventilation  
fan stutters in the silence, and in the stillness, you  
hear  the  occasional  rustle—something  is  alive  in 
here. But is it friend, foe… or something in between?”
 263 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
General Description

Layout:
o
Front of store: Rows of empty 
gardening shelves, shattered pottery, 
broken bags of soil spilling onto the tile 
floor.
o
Middle area: A half-looted section with 
gardening tools, fertilizer bags, and 
scattered seed packets.
o
Greenhouse (Back Area): A sealed-
off glass enclosure, humid and 
overgrown, filled with twisting vines, 
fungal blooms, and strange plant-
like growths.

Threats:
o
1d4+2 Shamblers tangled in vines, 
barely visible among the greenery.
o
1d2 “Spore Brutes”—massive 
zombies infested with fungal 
growths—lurking within the 
greenhouse.
o
A horrific mutant plant creature (The 
Vine-Twisted) may be encountered as 
a boss fight.

Hazards:
o
Collapsing Shelves: A careless 
movement may send metal racks 
crashing down (DEX DC 14 or take 
2d6 damage + noise attracts 
zombies).
o
Toxic Spores: Some plants in the 
greenhouse release spores when 
disturbed (CON DC 13 or suffer 
hallucinogenic visions for 1d4 rounds).
o
Overgrowth Trap: Thick vines grab at 
ankles (DEX DC 15 or be restrained).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Survival Seed Packets (15 SV) – 
Hardy plant seeds that can be 
cultivated in the mall for food.
2
Machete (Melee Weapon, 1d8 
damage, 30 SV) – Rusty but 
sharp, excellent for clearing foliage 
or zombies.
3
Industrial-Grade Fertilizer (25 
SV, or explosive component) – 
Can be used to improve food 
growth or rig an IED.
4
Bag of Soil (5 SV, but heavy) – 
Useless alone, but can be used to 
create a rooftop garden.
5
Rare Medicinal Plants (50 SV) – 
These herbs can be processed into 
antibiotics with the right tools.
6
Old Security Keycard – Found 
inside a rotting gardening glove, 
this might open a backroom or 
another store.
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered among the store are clues hinting at the 
mall’s dark history. Each piece of evidence is 
contradictory, leaving the players questioning the true 
cause of the apocalypse.
d4 Roll Ambiguous Clue
1
A BioDyne Corporation shipping 
manifest listing “Experimental 
Growth Accelerants” delivered a 
week before the outbreak.
2
A torn notebook with scrawled 
warnings: “The soil ate my fingers. 
The vines are watching. The plants 
aren’t dying… they’re thinking.”
3
A Bible verse spray-painted on 
the glass: “And the third trumpet 
sounded, and the green things rose 
against man…”
4
A security camera still running, 
its feed looping a blurry figure 
standing motionless in the 
 264 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
greenhouse. Every time you look 
away, the figure moves closer to 
the glass.
Tension Impact

Loud Noises (Shelves falling, gunfire, 
explosions, etc.): +1d4 to Tension.

Destroying the Vine-Twisted Boss: -1d6 to 
Tension (removing a major unnatural presence 
from the mall).

Using the greenhouse as a food source: 
Reduces supply drain, but may attract 
unknown entities over time.
Enemy Encounter Table
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Shamblers (1d4+2) – Zombies 
tangled in vines, slow but 
numerous.
3
Spore Brute (1d2) – Bulky 
zombies bloated with toxic fungal 
growths (explode on death).
4
Root-Crawlers (1d6) – Limbless 
undead partially fused with plant 
matter, dragging themselves 
towards warmth.
5
The Vine-Twisted (Boss) – A 
grotesque amalgamation of 
human corpses and plant 
matter, hungering for flesh.
6
Survivor-Trap (1d3) – A 
panicked survivor in hiding, but 
they might be infected…
Enemy Stats
Spore Brute

AC: 12, HP: 35

Attacks: Slam (1d10), Spore Burst (10-ft 
radius, CON DC 14 or poisoned for 1 min)

On Death: Explodes in toxic spores (CON DC 
15 or take 2d6 poison damage).
Root-Crawler

AC: 10, HP: 15

Attacks: Bite (1d6)

Special: Stealthy—DEX DC 13 to notice 
before they attack.
The Vine-Twisted (Boss Monster)
A towering mass of flesh and vines, pulsating with an 
unnatural rhythm. Its eyeless face turns toward the 
nearest source of heat—YOU.
- AC: 14, HP: 60
- Attacks:
- Tendril Slam (2d8)
- Root Grasp (DEX DC 15 or restrained)
- Special:
- Regeneration: Heals 5 HP per round unless set on 
fire.
- Spore Cloud: All melee attacks force a CON save 
(DC 15) or attacker suffers hallucinations.

(Every time players return to the store, roll 1d6 to

d6 Roll Event
1
The greenhouse glass is 
cracked open. Something got in… 
or out.
2
A survivor has been here 
recently. They left behind 
bloodstains and hurriedly packed 
supplies.
3
The plants have grown 
aggressively. Vines now block the 
entrance (must be cut through).
4
Muffled whispers come from 
inside. There is no one there.
5
A new plant has sprouted. It 
looks disturbingly like a human 
hand.
6
A military drone flies overhead. 
It pauses as if scanning the 
area, then leaves.

sites.name: Panel to Panel
sites.bookText:
Panel to Panel (Shop #29)
“Rows of toppled shelves and scattered comics litter 
the floor, their brightly colored covers faded under a 
layer  of  dust.  Cardboard  cutouts  of  long-forgotten 
superheroes  stand  as  silent  sentinels,  their  grins 
frozen in time. A massive Spider-Man poster looms 
overhead, now defaced with cryptic scrawls in black 
marker—‘THEY ARE STILL WATCHING.’ A life-sized 
Batman statue, cracked but upright, casts an ominous 
shadow under the dim emergency lighting. A glass 
display case at the back glints faintly, untouched, its 
treasures still locked away… for now. Somewhere, 
deep  within  the  store,  a  creak  echoes,  as  if 
someone… or something… is shifting between the 
aisles.”
General Description
Once a haven for comic book enthusiasts, Panel to 
Panel was a vibrant pop culture store filled with 
superhero memorabilia, graphic novels, and collectible 
figurines. Now, it’s a chaotic mess of upturned shelves, 
looted display cases, and torn posters. Some areas 
remain surprisingly intact, possibly because looters 
feared the unsettling mannequins in superhero 
costumes—or something worse. The store’s backroom 
and storage closet remain locked.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Cardboard Collapse: A precarious 
stack of cardboard cutouts topples 
over, causing 1d6 bludgeoning 
damage to anyone caught 
underneath and increasing Tension 
by +1d4 due to the noise.
2
Glass Shards: A shattered display 
case spreads razor-sharp shards 
across the floor. Moving through the 
area without care requires a 
Dexterity DC 12 check to avoid 1d4 
damage or making noise.
3
Statue Trap: A cracked Batman 
statue is dangerously unstable. If 
disturbed, it crashes down (DC 14 
Dex save or take 2d6 damage and 
create a loud noise, increasing 
Tension by +2d6).
4
Eerie Mannequin: A superhero 
mannequin falls forward 
suddenly when approached. It 
does no damage, but survivors 
must pass a DC 13 Wisdom 
(Sanity) save or panic, dropping 
an item or making noise.
 266 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
Interactables & Loot
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Rare Comic (Plastic-Sealed) – A 
mint-condition Superman #1 issue, 
worth 200 SV to the right collector.
2
Replica Katana (Blunt, but Sturdy) 
– Needs sharpening but functions as 
a 1d8 slashing weapon. Can be 
restored into a proper melee 
weapon.
3
Concealed Baseball Bat (Signed 
by a Celebrity) – A 1d6 
bludgeoning weapon, with value 
as a trade item (50 SV).
4

sites.name: Past & Present
sites.bookText:
Past & Present (Shop #30)
“Dim, golden light filters through the thick dust on the 
display cases, casting long, eerie shadows over racks 
of forgotten fashion and cluttered shelves. The air is 
thick with the scent of mothballs, old leather, and 
something faintly metallic. Glass display cases hold 
vintage watches, old cameras, and aged jewelry, their 
reflections warping in the cracked mirrors that line the 
walls. A mannequin in a faded 1920s dress stands 
eerily still, its glassy eyes watching over the shop as if 
it remembers better days. Somewhere in the back, 
something creaks… but there is no wind inside this 
mall.”
General Description
Once a thriving vintage boutique filled with rare finds 
and nostalgic treasures, Past & Present is now a dust-
coated time capsule of the past. It is crammed with 
clothing racks, display tables, and antique 
accessories, all shrouded in a layer of grime.
The cash register counter remains untouched, a 
faded “NO RETURNS” sign hanging behind it. A 
storeroom in the back holds locked cabinets, a few 
upturned mannequins, and a heavy safe with a 
mysterious rattle from inside.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (Roll 1d4 on 
entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Mannequin Trap – A rigged 
mannequin collapses loudly when 
the shop is entered. (+1d4 
Tension, 50% chance to attract 
1d4 zombies)
2
Rusted Clothing Racks – 
Navigating the store requires 
careful movement. (DEX DC 12 
check to avoid knocking over a 
rack and making noise.)
3
Swaying Light Fixtures – The 
flickering light swings ominously. If 
disturbed, it falls (DEX DC 14 to 
avoid 1d6 bludgeoning damage 
and +1d6 Tension).
4
Locked Safe – A heavy 
combination safe (INT DC 18 or 
Locksmith Tools) rattles 
slightly… but what is moving 
inside? (Spoiler: It’s a zombie 
hand.)
Interactables & Loot (Roll 1d6 
per search attempt)
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Classic Leather Jacket – Durable 
and stylish. Counts as Light Armor 
(AC 12 + DEX), valued at 50 SV.
2
Antique Pocket Watch – Engraved 
with initials “R.M.” Worth 100 SV or 
may be part of a larger mystery.
3
Vintage Camera – Fully functional. 
Can be traded for 75 SV or used 
to record evidence (if powered).
4
Hidden Dagger – Concealed inside 
an old cane. Functions as a dagger 
(1d4 damage, +1 to hit), valued at 
25 SV.
5
Safe Contents – Opening the 
locked safe reveals either (roll 
1d4): (1) A severed zombie hand, 
(2) 3d6 bullets, (3) Old cash 
(useless), (4) A military-grade 
radio (200 SV, requires repair).
 269 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
6
Strange Costume Piece – A 
plague doctor mask, Victorian 
gloves, or a handmade cult robe 
(purely aesthetic… or is it?).
Ambiguous Lore (Roll 1d4 for 
hidden clues)
d4 Roll Cryptic Clue
1
Bloodstained Note in a Coat 
Pocket – “We had to leave. Don’t 
trust the ones in white. They’re not 
human anymore.”
2
Hidden Cult Symbol – A strange 
sigil is scratched into the bottom of 
the checkout counter. It matches 
similar symbols in the occult 
bookstore.
3
Photo in a Locket – A black-and-
white photo of a smiling family… 
but something is off. The 
background mall signage 
doesn’t match the known stores.
4
BioDyne Lab Badge – A security 
pass for a now-defunct BioDyne 
facility. The ID photo is 
scratched out beyond 
recognition.
Tension Impact

Disturbing the mannequins, knocking over 
racks, or opening the safe: +1d6 Tension

Firing a gun inside the store: +2d6 Tension

Triggering a noise trap: Immediate zombie 
attraction check
Enemies & Encounters
d6 Roll Threat Present
1-2
Shambler Pack (1d4) – Basic 
zombies lurking between racks.
3
“The Lost Shopper” (Unique 
Zombie) – A former employee, still 
clutching a price scanner. Has 
slightly more intelligence than a 
standard zombie.
4
Crawler Zombie – Hidden beneath 
an overturned display case. Bites 
for 1d6 damage if stepped on.
5
The Hollow Mannequin – Looks 
like an ordinary mannequin until 
approached. Then it moves.
6
Silent Stalker – A mutated 
humanoid lurking in the back 
storage. It hunts silently and 
attacks when the lights flicker.
Special Enemy: “The Hollow 
Mannequin”

AC: 14 | HP: 20 | Speed: 10 ft. (30 ft. if 
unseen)

Attacks: Slam (1d6 bludgeoning), Grab 
(Restrains on hit, STR DC 14 to escape)

Special:
o
“Lifelike Stillness” – When 
motionless, it is indistinguishable from 
a normal mannequin. (Passive 
Perception DC 16 to notice 
something is wrong.)
o
“Jumpscare Movement” – If unseen 
for 1 full turn, it teleports 10 ft. closer 
to its target instead of moving 
normally.
XP & Survival Value (SV) 
Rewards
Action or Loot
SV Reward
Securing Past & 
Present entirely
200 SV

100 SV

50 SV
Military Radio (if 
fixed)
200 SV
Surviving an 
encounter with “The 
Hollow Mannequin”
+100 SV (bonus XP)
Survivor Strategy Notes

Scouting first: Before entering, survivors 
should check for traps, hazards, or signs of 
movement.

Avoid noise: Knocking over racks or triggering 
mannequins rapidly increases Tension, 
making it risky.

Optional engagement: The safe may hold 
valuable supplies, but forcing it open will 
cause noise. Players must decide whether to 
risk it.

Unraveling Lore: Players finding multiple lore 
items may piece together a larger mystery 
involving BioDyne, the cult, and the mall’s 
collapse.

sites.name: Play It Loud!
sites.bookText:
Play It Loud! (Shop #31)
“The scent of old leather and dust lingers in the air, 
mixed  with  something  sharp—like  dried  blood  or 
ozone. Cracked guitar cases lay abandoned on the 
floor, their contents missing or smashed beyond use. 
A grand drum set sits ominously in the corner, a 
single  drumstick  resting  atop  the  snare,  as  if 
someone  left  in  the  middle  of  a  song.  The  wall-
mounted  speakers,  still  powered  by  emergency 
battery backups, emit a faint hum, just waiting for a 
signal. Scattered sheet music flutters slightly, though 
no  wind  stirs.  The  eerie  silence  in  here  feels… 
unnatural—as  if  the  walls  themselves  are  holding 
their breath, waiting for the music to start again.”
General Description

Layout: A large, open floor space with 
instrument displays—guitars hanging from 
walls, a drum section near the back, and glass 
cases containing small electronics. A partially 
collapsed shelf leans precariously near the 
store entrance.

Threats: Zombies remain eerily still, seemingly 
“asleep” unless disturbed by loud noise.

Hazards:
o
Sound-Sensitive Zombies: Any 
significant noise (talking, moving fast, 
opening cases) risks waking them up.
o
Unstable Shelf Trap: The tilted 
display shelf near the entrance 
collapses if bumped, making a 
deafening crash (DC 13 DEX check to 
avoid or +2d6 Tension).
o
Feedback Loop: If players tinker with 
the powered speakers, an ear-piercing 
feedback screech (Tension +2d4) 
could occur, summoning nearby 
undead.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Electric Guitar (Functional, 
Unplugged) – Heavy enough to be 
a makeshift weapon (1d6 
bludgeoning damage).
2
Battery-Powered Amp (Working) 
– Can be used to attract or distract 
zombies.
3
Sheet Music for “Requiem for the 
Damned” – A cryptic song with 
strange occult annotations.
4
Heavy Drumsticks (Improvised 
Weapons, 1d4 bludgeoning each) 
– Surprisingly effective in skilled 
hands.
5
High-End Headphones (Still in 
Box, Worth 50 SV) – Could be 
 271

Zombie Mall
valuable for trade.
6
USB Drive Labeled “Project 
ECHO” – Corrupt audio files with 
distorted whispers and a garbled 
BioDyne Corporation log entry.
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered notes and damaged devices hint at strange 
occurrences before the mall fell.
| d4 Roll | Lore Clue | 
| 1 | A handwritten journal page describes a man 
“hearing music in his dreams” that “didn’t stop when he 
woke up.” | 
| 2 | Old concert posters featuring a band called The

“unforeseen events.” | 
| 3 | A distorted recording on a loop in a forgotten 
MP3 player whispers “They’re listening. Don’t let them 
hear the song.” | 
| 4 | A receipt from BioDyne Corp. addressed to 
“Soundwave Research Division - Neural Resonance 
Testing.” |


If survivors sneak carefully (DC 14 Stealth) 
and exit without making a sound, they avoid 
all encounters.

If they fight, nearby zombies (1d4 from the 
mall) may be drawn by the noise.
Summary

Play It Loud! is a high-risk, high-reward store 
due to its sound-based hazards and lore 
clues.

The USB drive and sheet music may hint at a 
deeper mall mystery—or unleash something 
worse.

Players can clear the store quietly, or chaos 
can erupt instantly with a single mistake.
Optional Boss: “The 
Conductor”

If the USB file plays fully, a ghostly figure 
wielding a jagged conductor’s baton 
materializes from the store’s speakers.

It conducts an invisible orchestra, forcing 
players to move in sync with its music (or 
take psychic damage).

It cannot be harmed conventionally—only 
through disrupting its music (or breaking the 
speakers).

Defeating it grants a unique item: The Baton 
of Silence, which allows the wielder to nullify 
sound within 30ft once per day.

sites.name: Trailblazers
sites.bookText:
Trailblazers (Shop #32)
“The air inside Trailblazers is thick with the scent of 
mildew and damp canvas. Racks of high-end hiking 
gear stand abandoned, their price tags fluttering in 
the stale air. Boots, tents, and backpacks are still 
neatly arranged, but a faint trail of dried blood smears 
across the linoleum floor, leading toward the dressing 
rooms in the back. A shattered glass display case 
once housed expensive hunting knives—now, only a 
single blade remains, stuck deep in the torso of a 
long-dead  corpse  slumped  against  the  counter. 
Somewhere in the darkness, a faint rustling sound 
echoes,  as  if  something—or  someone—is  still 
inside…”
Description

Layout:
Trailblazers is a mid-sized outdoor gear 
store with an open sales floor featuring 
displays of hiking boots, backpacks, and 
survival gear. A checkout counter stands 
near the entrance, with a shattered display 
case behind it. The back of the store 
contains changing rooms, a storeroom, 
and an employees-only access door 
leading to a loading dock.

Threats:
o
1d4+1 Crawler Zombies are hiding 
under clothing racks or slumped 
behind counters, waiting for 
movement.
o
1 “Mountain Man” Zombie (a former 
survivalist, now undead) lurks near the 
storage room, wearing a tattered camo 
jacket and wielding a hatchet still 
embedded in his skull.
o
Possible Ambush – Any loud noise 
(breaking glass, yelling) will wake 1d6 
zombies in the nearby corridor, 
drawn to the store in 1d4 rounds.

Hazards:
o
Loose Rope Trap: Someone rigged a 
makeshift snare trap in the back of 
the store (DEX DC 14 to notice, DC 16 
to avoid). If triggered, a rope yanks the 
victim upside down and suspends 
them in midair, leaving them 
vulnerable to attack.
 273 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
o
Collapsed Shelf: A heavy metal 
shelving unit leans precariously. If 
disturbed, it will collapse (DEX DC 12 
to dodge, or take 2d6 bludgeoning 
damage and be pinned).

checks). |

+2 to repair/crafting). |

Survival Gear

SV). |

cooking anywhere, 100 SV). |

Navigation rolls, reveals potential escape routes). | 
| 5 | High-Quality Tent (Protects against rain, wind, and 
small animals, 125 SV). | 
| 6 | Pack of Freeze-Dried Meals (4 days’ worth of 
food, 40 SV). |
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered notes, cryptic messages, and bloodstains hint 
at the origins of the apocalypse—but nothing makes 
perfect sense.
d4 Roll

started in the mountains. 
Something ancient woke up 
there. We should’ve never

parasites.” Last entry: “They got

burnt paper reading

Keep the infected out of high-
altitude zones.”

on the island. The infection 
can’t cross the water…”

HP: 10 each





Special: Hidden among racks—Stealth DC 13 
to spot before they grab ankles. If they hit, the 
target must make a STR DC 14 check to break 
free.
“Mountain Man” Zombie

HP: 18

AC: 12 (Thick Camo Jacket)

Attack:
o
Hatchet Swing (1d8 slashing)
o
Bite (1d6, chance of infection)

Special:
o
Unkillable Without Removing 
Hatchet: If reduced to 0 HP, it 
“revives” next round unless someone 
removes the hatchet embedded in its 
skull. STR DC 14 check to pull it out.
o
Knows How to Track: Follows 
survivors who flee, leaving strange 
symbols on walls.
Special Encounter: “The Last 
Camper”
A malnourished but armed survivor (a former park 
ranger) is hiding in the storage room, surviving off 
freeze-dried rations. He’s paranoid and wounded, 
mistaking the players for zombies at first.

Reaction Roll (1d6)
o
1-2: Hostile – Shoots first, asks 
questions later.
o
3-4: Paranoid – Holds them at 
gunpoint but listens.
o
5-6: Cooperative – Willing to trade 
supplies or offer intel.

If befriended, he can provide a map of the 
surrounding area, revealing possible military 
supply drops or escape routes to “the 
island.”

If killed, he carries:
o
Hunting Rifle (2d6, requires ammo)
o
3 Days of Food
o
Pocket Compass (+1 Navigation 
rolls)
Escape Route Opportunity
If players search thoroughly, they find a map and 
coordinates leading to an abandoned ranger station 
(potential future safe zone or escape point).
If players leave this store intact, scavengers or rival 
survivors may loot it first (forcing players to fight for 
remaining supplies later).

sites.bookText:
Radiance Boutique (Shop 
#33)
“The sickly-sweet scent of old perfume clings to the 
air,  mixing  with  the  stench  of  decay.  Rows  of 
shattered glass cases line the boutique, their once-
luxurious  contents  scattered  across  the  tiled  floor. 
Lipstick  tubes,  cracked  foundation  bottles,  and 
designer  perfumes  lay  abandoned  like  relics  of  a 
forgotten world. A massive, wall-length mirror stands 
at the back of the store—its surface smeared with 
bloody  handprints.  Faint  movement  flickers  in  the 
reflection, but when you turn to look, nothing is there. 
Somewhere, hidden among the wreckage, something 
breathes softly.”
General Description
Radiance Boutique was once an elite cosmetics store 
catering to the wealthy and vain. Now, it stands as a 
 275 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
broken shrine to beauty, with cracked makeup palettes, 
broken compacts, and ruined skincare jars littering the 
floor. The boutique’s pink-and-gold walls are smeared 
with grime, and an eerie glow flickers from dying LED 
lights.
A large display counter still holds a handful of 
untouched items—sealed perfumes, high-end skincare 
products, and gilded beauty tools that might be worth 
something to the right buyer. At the back of the store, a 
storeroom door hangs ajar, leading to a dark, 
perfume-choked storage space filled with toppled 
shelves. The wall-length mirror seems to shimmer 
unnaturally, as if something watches from the other 
side.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll
Hazard
1
Shattered Glass Everywhere: 
Moving through the store without 
care (DEX DC 12) results in a 
painful misstep (1d4 damage, 
50% chance of attracting 
zombies).
2
The Mirror’s Trick: Looking too 
long into the mirror (WIS DC 14) 
causes brief hallucinations of a 
perfect, untouched self—so 
convincing it delays a survivor for 
1d6 rounds in a daze.
3
Perfume Bomb: Disturbing a 
toppled shelf releases a massive, 
choking perfume cloud (CON 
DC 13 or suffer -2 to Perception 
for 1 hour). Also increases 
Tension +1d6 as the scent 
spreads.
4
Hanging Display Rack: A loose 
ceiling-mounted display could 
collapse if disturbed (DEX DC 
15 to avoid, 2d6 bludgeoning 
damage, noise attracts zombies 
in nearby rooms).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Luxury Perfume (Sealed) – Could 
be traded for 50 SV or used to mask 
scents for stealth (Advantage on 
Stealth vs. zombies for 1 hour).
2
Glass-Cased Lipstick Knife – A 
hidden lipstick blade (1d4 piercing, 
easily concealable).
3
High-End Skincare Set – Worth 75 
SV in trade with certain NPCs (like 
a vain cultist or black-market 
trader).
4
Nail File Shiv – Improvised weapon 
(1d4 piercing, grants +2 Sleight of 
Hand for lockpicking attempts).
5
Mirrored Compact – Reflective 
surface acts as a periscope, useful 
for spotting threats around corners.
6
The “Beauty Box” – A locked 
employee case (DEX DC 15 to 
pick, STR DC 16 to break) 
containing a taser (1d8 electric 
damage, 50% chance to stun for 
1 round) and a bundle of cash 
(useless, but fun to burn).
Ambiguous Lore
Hidden among the wreckage are small, cryptic clues 
that hint at the mall’s mysterious downfall:
d4 Roll Ambiguous Clue
1
A half-burned employee log 
mentioning a customer “undergoing 
The Perfecting Process in the back 
room”—no details, just a warning to 
“never break the mirror.”
2
A scrawled lipstick message on 
the mirror: “Beauty is eternal. We 
never leave.” Touching it makes it 
feel warm.
 276 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
3
A receipt for an unusual bulk 
order—hundreds of gallons of 
blood-red liquid labeled only as 
“Elixir No. 6.”
4
A security camera logbook—the 
final entry describes “a woman in 
the mirror who shouldn’t be 
there” before cutting off abruptly.
Potential Enemies
d6 Roll Encounter
1-2
Shambler Pack (1d4 Zombies) – 
Mindless former customers, still 
clutching ruined makeup items.
3
The Model (Special Enemy) – A 
ghoulishly perfect corpse, 
standing motionless at the back of 
the store—until someone sees her 
reflection move differently.
4
Swarm of Skeletal Hands – From 
inside the wall mirror, a clawing 
swarm of undead hands reaches 
out (grapples +1d6 damage).
5
Living Mannequins (2) – Store 
mannequins reanimate if 
disturbed, attacking like soulless 
fashion zombies.
6
Cursed Mirror Horror – If a 
survivor lingers too long looking 
into the mirror, their reflection 
emerges to attack—a perfect, 
horrifying mockery of themself.

- HP: 25
- AC: 14
- Speed: 30 ft
- Attack: Clawed Hands (1d8 slashing)
- Special: If she is seen moving in the mirror but not

- Attack: Heavy Blow (1d6 bludgeoning)
- Special: Immobile until approached; cannot be

- AC: Mirrors survivor’s AC
- Attacks: Mirrors survivor’s best attack
- Special: Can only be harmed when facing away

sites.name: Gear & Grit
sites.bookText:
Gear & Grit (Shop #34)
“A chemical tang of rubber and motor oil lingers in the 
air as you step inside this half-looted auto accessory 
shop.  Rows  of  shelving  units,  once  filled  with 
 277 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
emergency  road  kits  and  car  batteries,  are  now 
overturned, their contents scattered across a grime-
covered  floor.  Dim  fluorescent  bulbs  flicker 
intermittently,  casting  erratic  shadows  over  dented 
gas  canisters  and  shattered  windshield  wipers.  A 
single car horn honks softly in the distance, its dying 
battery  sending  out  one  last,  wheezing  groan. 
Something about this place feels… unstable.”
General Description
Gear & Grit was once the go-to place for car 
enthusiasts and road-trippers, selling everything from 
tire repair kits to fuzzy dice. Now, it’s a wreck—like 
someone made a frantic last-minute attempt to grab 
anything useful before things went south.

Layout:
o
Narrow aisles with toppled shelves, 
creating small crawl spaces.
o
A partially looted counter, its register 
pried open.
o
A garage-style backroom (locked) 
with a maintenance pit beneath a 
rusting sedan.
o
A wrecked self-service kiosk, its 
touchscreen still cracked but dimly 
flashing “Please Select an Option.”

Threats (1d6 roll upon entering):
d6 Roll
Threat Present
1-2
No zombies—just eerie silence 
and the smell of stale gasoline.
3
1d4 Shamblers—former 
mechanics in grease-streaked 
uniforms.
4
Crawler Zombies (2)—half-
crushed under an overturned 
shelf.
5
A gas-soaked zombie—burning 
torch, bullet, or sparks could ignite 
it!
6
“Living” Mannequin—someone 
dressed a corpse up like an 
employee… until it moves.

Hazards:
o
Fuel Spill: A slick puddle of gasoline 
coats part of the floor. Any fire-based 
attack ignites a 10-ft. radius explosion 
(3d6 fire damage).
o
Falling Shelves: Any loud movement 
(failing a Stealth DC 12) has a 30% 
chance of causing an unstable shelf to 
collapse (Dexterity DC 13 to avoid 2d6 
damage).
o
Unstable Car Battery: A corroded 
battery leaks acid onto the floor. 
Touching it causes 1d4 acid damage 
and ruins any metal objects left in the 
area too long.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Emergency Road Kit (10 SV) – 
Contains flares, jumper cables, 
and a flashlight.
2
Tire Iron (Melee Weapon, 1d8 
bludgeoning) – Found under the 
counter, slightly rusted but usable.
3
Gas Canister (15 SV, also an 
improvised firebomb if modified) 
– Partially full, marked with “NOT 
FOR SALE.”
4
CB Radio (50 SV) – Found in the 
back office, can be hooked up to a 
power source to scan for 
broadcasts.
5
Keys to the Sedan in the 
Backroom – But does it still 
work…?
6
Junk Parts (various, 5 SV each) 
– Wires, bolts, fuses—useful for 
crafting or repairing electronics.
Special Find:

Sedan in the Backroom – This rusting car 
might still work. Players can attempt to 
 278 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
jumpstart it (Intelligence DC 15, 1d4 
attempts allowed).
o
Success: The Sedan (250 SV) is 
drivable!
o
Failure: The battery explodes (2d6 
damage, ignites fuel spill if present).
Ambiguous Lore: Strange 
Clues
Scattered among the wreckage are hints about what 
happened at the mall. Players can roll Investigation 
(DC 14) to find one of these:
d4 Roll Lore Clue
1
Oil-stained Military Directive: 
Mentions securing “biofuel 
samples” and containing “Protocol 
Zulu incidents.”
2
Torn Sales Receipt: Lists a 
purchase of “lead shielding plates” 
and a “Geiger counter” a week 
before the outbreak.
3
Mechanic’s Notebook: Has 
scribbled notes about strange “goo” 
in the oil filters of multiple customer 
vehicles.
4
Graffiti in the Restroom: Reads: 
“THEY’RE ALREADY DEAD. 
STOP FEEDING THEM. - M”

+1d4 Tension

-5 Tension

Grit


AC: 8, HP: 12 each

Attack: Slam (1d6 damage, 25% chance of 
infection)

Slow & Clumsy: Easy to outrun unless 
cornered.
Crawler Zombies (2)

AC: 10, HP: 8 each

Attack: Bite (1d6 damage, attempts grapple)


Gas-Soaked Zombie

AC: 9, HP: 10


AC: 12, HP: 15


Special: If reduced to 0 HP, reanimates after

100 XP

Someone else might be looking for fuel, and they won’t 
ask nicely…

sites.name: SereniTea Lounge
sites.bookText:
SereniTea Lounge (Shop 
#35)
“The scent of long-forgotten jasmine, chamomile, and 
oolong lingers in the air, mixing with the acrid tang of 
mildew. Ornate teapots and delicate cups sit atop 
wooden shelves, coated in a thin layer of dust. A low, 
ambient  chime  hums  through  the  space—the  last 
remnants of a relaxation playlist still looping endlessly 
from  a  battery-powered  speaker.  A  once-soothing 
haven,  the  shop  now  feels  unnervingly  still,  as  if 
something waits among the overturned chairs and 
shattered  porcelain.  The  calming  atmosphere  is  a 
cruel joke—your every breath feels too loud, your 
every step an intrusion into something that should 
remain undisturbed.”
General Description
Once a peaceful sanctuary for tea lovers, SereniTea 
Lounge was known for its artisanal loose-leaf blends, 
delicate porcelain teapots, and a calming ambiance. 
The store was designed for relaxation, with soft 
seating, warm wooden shelves, and gentle 
background music. Now, the space is frozen in time—
tea canisters spilled across the counters, half-drunk 
cups of tea long since evaporated, and an eerie quiet 
only interrupted by the occasional creak of shifting 
furniture.

Layout: A central counter where tea was 
prepared, wall-to-wall wooden shelves 
stocked with tea tins, and a small tasting area 
with low tables and plush seating. A back 
storage room contains a break area and extra 
supplies.

Threats: Something moved back there. Could 
be one slow-moving zombie caught behind 
the counter… or something worse.

Hazards: The floor is covered in shattered 
porcelain—moving too quickly might cause 
noise. The ambient chime system 
occasionally restarts, creating unpredictable 
sound hazards.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (Roll 1d4 upon 
entering)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Falling Shelves: A tall tea shelf is 
unstable. Moving near it (STR 
check DC 12) causes it to collapse, 
dealing 1d6 damage and making a 
loud crash (+1d4 Tension).
2
Porcelain Trap: A floor section is 
covered in shattered teacups. 
Moving over it at full speed (DEX 
DC 14) causes 1d4 slashing 
damage and creates noise (+1d3 
Tension).
 280 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
3
Faulty Speaker System: The old 
ambient chime malfunctions, 
suddenly playing at full volume. 
(Instantly increases Tension by 
+2d4 and attracts zombies from 
nearby rooms.)
4
Trapped Door (Back Room): A 
corpse is slumped against the 
storeroom door. Opening it 
improperly will spill the body 
onto the floor, making a loud 
noise (+1d6 Tension).
Interactables & Loot (Roll 1d6 
for each section searched.)
Main Counter (Tea Preparation Area)
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Artisanal Tea Collection (10 SV 
each, total 50 SV) – High-end 
loose-leaf tea blends that could be 
used for trade or morale boosts.
2
Butane Lighter (15 SV) – Needed

makeshift explosives.
3
Old Cash Register – Containing

4

5

a clue to something sinister.
6

stained paper scrawled with 
“The sixth seal is broken. We 
must drink deeply before the 
awakening.” (Ambiguous Lore 
Clue)

searched.)
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Water Filtration Kit (50 SV) – A

purification of tainted water.
2

fuel) – Allows survivors to cook 
properly and increase morale.
3
Hidden Cache (Locked Box, DEX 
DC 15 to open) – Contains a 
revolver (25 SV) with 5 rounds 
(10 SV each).
4
Moldy Tea Leaves – Could be 
processed into a mild medicinal 
or used as a weak poison.
5
Journal Entry from an Ex-
Employee – Details strange

sites.name: Back Issues
sites.bookText:
Back Issues (Shop #36)
“The  store  is  a  tomb  of  nostalgia.  Shelves  once 
brimming with brightly colored comic books are now 
bare or strewn across the floor, their pages torn and 
yellowing. A broken cash register sits on the counter 
next to a faded ‘Free Comic Book Day’ poster. The 
lingering scent of musty paper and melted plastic fills 
the  air.  A  toppled  cardboard  cutout  of  a  masked 
superhero  leans  awkwardly  against  a  shattered 
display  case.  In  the  dim  light,  something  moves 
behind  the  aisles—just  the  settling  debris…  or 
something else?”
General Description
Once a haven for comic lovers, Back Issues is now a 
wreck of tattered pages and shattered dreams. Long 
boxes of comics have been rifled through, their contents 
either burned, looted, or left to rot. A few intact graphic 
novels remain, their vibrant covers standing out against 
the surrounding decay.
 282 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level

Layout: Narrow aisles filled with toppled 
bookshelves and longboxes. A small back 
room (employees only) is still locked. A 
reading nook in the corner has a few broken 
chairs and an overturned table.

Threats: 1d4 Shamblers lurking near the back 
room, attracted by movement and sound. A 
“Super-Zombie” (see below) has been 
dormant in the storage area.

Hazards:
o
Torn Pages on the Floor: Moving too 
fast may cause slipping (DC 12 
Dexterity save or fall prone).
o
Leaning Bookshelves: Heavy 
shelving threatens to collapse if 
disturbed (Strength DC 15 to stop, or 
2d6 bludgeoning damage).
o
Decayed Ceiling Tile: A large tile is 
unstable. Loud noises (or an unlucky 
roll) may cause it to crash down (1d8 
damage, attracts zombies).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items Found
1
Rare Collector’s Edition Comic – 
Sealed and worth 75 SV if sold or 
traded. May interest certain NPCs.
2
Improvised Paper Armor – 
Layered comic books strapped 
together (AC 12, disadvantage on 
stealth due to crinkling sound).
3
Prop Replica Sword (Blunt) – 
Can be modified into a real 
weapon (1d6 damage, breakable).
4
Cash Register – Locked (DC 14 
Dexterity check to open). Contains 
50 SV worth of small bills, useless 
for survival but good for bartering.
5
Longbox with Hidden Stash – A 
survivor hid supplies inside. 
Contains 2 ration packs (10 SV), a 
flashlight (15 SV), and a pack of 
AA batteries (5 SV).
6
Old Security Footage (USB 
Drive) – Found in the back room. 
Contains blurry footage of 
something moving unnaturally 
fast in the mall before 
everything went wrong. Lore 
clue.
Ambiguous Lore
d4 Roll Clue Found
1
A fan letter pinned to the wall 
raves about a comic series 
predicting an “unstoppable 
outbreak” years before it happened. 
The writer signed it, “Eager Reader 
#6.”
2
A handwritten note in a 
superhero sketchbook warns, 
“They took my friend. Said she was 
‘special’—something about an 
experiment. If you’re reading this, 
GET OUT.”
3
Comic with Marked Pages: A 
zombie-apocalypse comic has 
specific panels underlined, hinting 
at real-world locations in the mall 
where something important might 
be hidden.
4
Backroom Whiteboard: Faded 
ink outlines what looks like a 
schedule of government 
broadcasts before the outbreak. 
The last entry reads, “Emergency 
Protocol Z… and then silence.”

may escape its lips if observed carefully.
